BiblicalUsage: Blindness is the curse on a people who will not see, and the promise on the horses of their enemies. In Deuteronomy 28:28 the LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart, in Zechariah 12:4 God says he will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness, and in Leviticus 22:22 the blind animal is not to be offered to the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that blindness in these verses is never only about eyes: a people who will not see are struck with not seeing. God opens the eyes of those who ask.
